sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A complete portrait 4:5 production game puzzle painting. Rich warm painterly oil/gouache illustration with fine believable materials, coherent perspective, inviting natural light, clean crisp detail; not a photograph or flat vector. No letters, logos, numbers, landmarks, border or UI. Full bleed varied detail, clear focus. This is a clean background plate; leave the specific tiny moving details below absent, and paint their anchor surfaces naturally. Do not leave holes. A gently elevated view along a mountain village path between cozy timber homes whose large painted wooden wall panels, doors and shutters are TURQUOISE. Rugged mountains, alpine flowers, stone steps, warm brown beams. Turquoise dominates near facades, no identifiable real destination. Include one empty wall flowerpot at right near doorway, one empty black wrought hook on left timber beam, a taut decorative cord across path with an empty middle span, a low shrub with short bare stem at bottom-left, and an empty small bud vase on a window ledge left. Later animated details will be flower, hanging miniature lantern, cloth pennant, leaf branch and tiny flower sprig. All anchors visible, not at image edge.

Complete natural painted subjects.

Entire complete object centered with huge 25 percent transparent padding all around, no glow, labels, grid, text or additional objects. Main blossom cluster compact, green stem long enough to insert into an existing painting's pot.
